Population increased in Wakefield

The estimated population of Wakefield in 2024 was 367,666 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

This meant that Wakefield's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wakefield increased by 3.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wakefield was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wakefield

The average (median) age fell to 41 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wakefield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wakefield is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wakefield's population of 367,666 usual residents was made up of:

  • 68,791 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.7%)
  • 228,654 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.2%)
  • 70,221 people aged 65 years and over, (19.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wakefield has a similar proportion of people in these age categories.

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wakefield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wakefield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wakefield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 45 people (0%). In total, there were 3,652 births and 3,697 deaths in Wakefield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,535 (0.7%). There were 15,689 people entering the area and 13,154 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wakefield's population of 2,171 (0.6%) as a result of 3,165 people entering the area and 994 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wakefield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wakefield in mid-2023 is 363,013.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 773 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 454 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,227 people.
